title: tephroseris integrifolia subsp. primulifolia
intro: Tephroseris integrifolia subsp. primulifolia, commonly known as the Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various health issues such as skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Everlasting include antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
